name: Fox Market
rootCause: FoxMarket (a DeFi project on BSC) had its FoxLpBondsPool.stake() function calculate and fix _stakeAmount from a manipulable Pancake AMM spot quote before a large USDT→Fox swap. The attacker used flash loans to skew pair reserves, then addLiquidity used a mismatched ratio; Treasury.lpBonds() trusted the stale value, minted excess Fox tokens, and sent inviter rewards to an attacker-controlled address, which were sold in the same transaction.
